server.name: cleanor
server.instructions: Cleanor tools for AI builders. Use optimize_image to shrink/convert an image an AI generated or dropped in (returns the optimized bytes + before/after size). Use storage_capacity and image_format_savings for real, cited Cleanor Labs data on device storage and image formats. Use qr_code for a paste-ready SVG QR. No API key needed. Every result links its cleanor.app source.

dimensions.title: Schema Health
dimensions.summary: Structural validity of each tool's JSON input schema: valid schema, typed and described properties, and a consistent required list.

dimensions.title: Description Quality (heuristic)
dimensions.summary: Offline heuristics on tool descriptions (presence and length). An LLM-judged 'can an agent tell when to use this?' score is added in the agentic stage.

dimensions.title: Security Signals
dimensions.summary: Static scan of the server's init instructions plus tool and parameter descriptions for tool-poisoning / prompt-injection markers and hidden characters (Invariant Labs / OWASP MCP threat model).

dimensions.title: Agent Task Success
dimensions.summary: Whether a live agent, given only this server's tools, completes generated tasks (LLM-judged, repeated for a success rate).

dimensions.title: Tool-Selection Accuracy
dimensions.summary: Whether the agent called the tools each task was expected to use.

dimensions.title: Tool Reliability
dimensions.summary: Fraction of the agent's tool calls the server executed without error — a server-quality signal distinct from whether the agent finished the task.

dimensions.title: Response Safety (runtime)
dimensions.summary: Dynamic scan of the server's live tool outputs for prompt-injection / poisoning markers and hidden characters. Markers here may be the server poisoning its responses, or untrusted content it passed through — either exposes the agent. Reported (and it lowers the score) but does not cap the grade on its own. Reflects the outputs the generated tasks happened to elicit, so it can vary run to run.

dimensions.title: Robustness
dimensions.summary: Fraction of probed tools that reject malformed / schema-violating arguments — a well-behaved server rejects them rather than silently accepting, hanging, or crashing (LLM-free).

results.description: Generate a complementary color palette using the base color '#2A64C5'. Take the complementary color returned by the palette generator and create a 400x200 SVG placeholder image using this color as its background ('bg') and displaying the text 'Preview'.
results.rubric: Verify that the agent invoked 'color_palette' with color '#2A64C5' and harmony 'complementary'. Then verify that 'placeholder_image' was invoked with width 400, height 200, bg set to the complementary hex color returned by the palette tool, and text set to 'Preview'.

results.description: Decode the JSON Web Token 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ1c2VyXzEyMzQ1Njc4OTAiLCJuYW1lIjoiQWxpY2UgSm9obnNvbiIsImlhdCI6MTUxNjIzOTAyMiwiZXhwIjoxNzM1Njg5NjAwfQ.signature' to inspect its claims. Convert the 'exp' Unix timestamp into ISO format in the 'UTC' timezone, and use the character counting tool to determine the exact character count of the 'sub' claim value.
results.rubric: Verify that the agent called 'jwt_decode' with the provided token, called 'datetime' with input 1735689600 and timezone 'UTC', and called 'count' with the string 'user_1234567890'. Ensure the final response correctly reports the converted timestamp (2025-01-01T00:00:00Z) and character count (15).

results.description: Convert 500 gigabytes (gb) to mebibytes (mib) using the unit conversion tool. Then compute a SHA-256 HMAC hex signature of the exact numeric result using the secret key 'secret_api_key_2025'.
results.rubric: Verify that the agent called 'unit_convert' with value 500, from 'gb', and to 'mib'. Verify that 'hmac' was subsequently called using the result of the conversion as the message, 'secret_api_key_2025' as secret, 'SHA-256' as algorithm, and 'hex' encoding.
